rules.name: CVE-2026-53362 — Kernel Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-53362: Linux Kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability that can allow for privilege escalation via IPv6 networking subsystem. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to Suse, Red Hat, and other products using Linux. . Product: Kernel
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message has "CVE-2026-53362" or RuleName has "CVE-2026-53362" or ProcessName has "CVE-2026-53362" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, EventID | where count_ > 5 // AZ-PRIVILEGE-ESCALATION-002

rules.name: CVE-2015-3246 — Libuser Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2015-3246: Red Hat libuser contains a race condition vulnerability that allows authenticated local users to corrupt the /etc/passwd file to cause a denial of service or privilege escalation. . Product: Libuser
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message has "CVE-2015-3246" or RuleName has "CVE-2015-3246" or ProcessName has "CVE-2015-3246" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, EventID | where count_ > 5 // AZ-PRIVILEGE-ESCALATION-005

rules.name: CVE-2015-5287 — Automatic Bug Reporting Tool Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2015-5287: Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool (ABRT) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that could allow local users with certain permissions to gain privileges via a symlink attack on a file with a predictable name. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.. Product: Automatic Bug Reporting Tool
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message has "CVE-2015-5287" or RuleName has "CVE-2015-5287" or ProcessName has "CVE-2015-5287" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, EventID | where count_ > 5 // AZ-PRIVILEGE-ESCALATION-006

rules.name: CVE-2026-86060 — RouterOS Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-86060: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacked to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.. Product: RouterOS
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "CVE-2026-86060" or Message contains "ROUTEROS" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), clientIp_s | where count_ > 3
